QiImbalance.name: Qi Imbalance
QiImbalance.description: Increases Qi damage taken by 10%. Increases global HP damage taken by 8% during exhausted, and an additional 8% for Bellstrike damage.

SwordSlashDamageBoost.name: Sword Slash Damage Boost
SwordSlashDamageBoost.description: Increases SwordEnergy skill damage by 10% per stack, up to 3 stacks. Hits refresh the 8-second duration.
